edits.speaker: Domon

edits.after: He must cast aside his complacency, overcome his fear, and hone the life force within him to its very limit.
edits.reason: Domon is telling Kaine to abandon the complacency that comes from believing training cannot cost him his life. The point is not simply to stop relying on other people.
